name: agent-plugins
description: Plugins for Claude Code and Codex. Each plugin passes a security gate before release and lists the harnesses and models it was tested on, the permissions it needs and what it must be installed with.

plugins.name: docs-index
plugins.description: Keeps a project's docs/ tree with a one-line-summary INDEX.md and an MLA BIBLIOGRAPHY.md with cited-by links.

plugins.name: session-checkpoint
plugins.description: Proves before a restart that everything the owner said and the session produced is saved where the next session reads.

plugins.name: ui-design-process
plugins.description: Agent-run UI design with competing designer personas, critique, audits, judging, fusion and a studio page.

plugins.name: word-codes
plugins.description: Adjective-animal codes read on one screen and typed or compared on another, with the shared lists and module.
